goalSpec.goal: Find a train connection from Prague to Bratislava for April 18th, departing at 18:30. Identify the first suitable connection and report its departure and arrival times.
successCriteria: The cookie consent dialog is no longer visible.
The date is set to April 18th, 2026.
Train connection search results are displayed.
assumptions: The website is stable and its elements are consistently locatable.
There will be at least one train connection available from Prague to Bratislava on April 18th at or after 18:30.

subtasks.title: Accept all cookies to dismiss the consent overlay.
Click the 'Hledat' (Search) button to find connections.
Extract the departure and arrival times of the first connection that meets the criteria.
